source: OWASP GenAI Security Project — OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications for 2026
note: Unlike MITRE ATLAS, OWASP publishes this list as a PDF only — the OWASP Agentic Security Initiative has no machine-readable release. The ten ids and names below are transcribed by hand from that document, which is why this layer is secondary and version-pinned rather than vendored and hashed like atlas.json. This is a different taxonomy from the earlier OWASP 'Agentic AI Threats and Mitigations' (v1.0, February 2025), which numbers its threats T1 through T15; the ASI-prefixed ids here belong only to the 2026 Top 10 for Agentic Applications.
